attr.title: Insaniquarium Deluxe
attr.desc:
Insaniquarium Deluxe (PopCap, 2004) running natively on aarch64.

Not an emulator: this is the WinFish decompilation of the game, ported from the original SexyAppFramework to PopLib, which replaces DirectDraw with SDL3. Module music is played with libopenmpt. The binary is native aarch64 and depends on no closed-source libraries.

The game is played entirely with the pointer, so the gamepad acts as a mouse: stick and d-pad move it, A left clicks, B right clicks, and L1/R1 slow it down for hitting coins and small fish.

KNOWN ISSUE: on the R36S, using the hardware volume buttons during a game can freeze the picture briefly. Reports from other devices are welcome.
attr.inst:
This port does NOT include the game. Copy the data, images, music, properties, sounds and fishsongs folders from your copy of Insaniquarium Deluxe (Steam or GOG) into ports/insaniquarium/.

Watch the letter case: Windows ignores it and Linux does not. If the game complains about an image that clearly exists, that is almost always why.
